skill_introduction.english: After this Technique is used, there is a <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> for each enemy to be inflicted with 1 stack of <u>Arcana</u> at the start of the next battle. For each successful application of <u>Arcana</u> on a target, inflicts another stack of <u>Arcana</u> on the same target. This process repeats until <u>Arcana</u> fails to be inflicted on this target. For each successive application of <u>Arcana</u> on a target, its <u>base chance</u> of success is equal to <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of the <u>base chance</u> of the previous successful infliction of <u>Arcana</u> on that target.

skill_introduction.chinese: 对指定敌方单体造成等同于真理医生<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的虚数属性伤害。
skill_introduction.english: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Dr. Ratio's ATK to one designated enemy target.

skill_introduction.chinese: 对指定敌方单体造成等同于真理医生<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的虚数属性伤害。
skill_introduction.english: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Dr. Ratio's ATK to one designated enemy target.

skill_introduction.chinese: 对指定敌方单体造成等同于真理医生<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的虚数属性伤害，并附上【智者的短见】。真理医生的队友攻击持有【智者的短见】的目标时，真理医生对该目标发动1次天赋的<u>追加攻击</u>。\n【智者的短见】效果最多触发<unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>次且仅对真理医生终结技最新施放的目标生效。施放终结技后重置该效果触发次数。
skill_introduction.english: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Dr. Ratio's ATK to one designated enemy target and applies "Wiseman's Folly." When Dr. Ratio's teammates attack a target afflicted with "Wiseman's Folly," Dr. Ratio launches 1 instance of his Talent's <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> against this target.\n"Wiseman's Folly" can be triggered for up to <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> times and only affects the most recent target of Dr. Ratio's Ultimate. This trigger count resets after Dr. Ratio's Ultimate is used.

skill_introduction.chinese: 施放战技时，有<unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>的<u>固定概率</u>对该目标发动1次<u>追加攻击</u>，造成等同于真理医生<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的虚数属性伤害。目标每有1个负面效果，<u>追加攻击</u>发动的<u>固定概率</u>提高<unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>。若<u>追加攻击</u>施放前目标被消灭则对敌方随机单体发动<u>追加攻击</u>。
skill_introduction.english: When using his Skill, Dr. Ratio has a <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> <u>fixed chance</u> of launching a <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> against his target for 1 time, dealing Imaginary DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Dr. Ratio's ATK. For each debuff the target enemy has, the <u>fixed chance</u> of launching <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> increases by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>. If the target enemy is defeated before the <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> triggers, the <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> will be directed at a single random enemy instead.

After entering battle with enemies in this Special Dimension, there is a <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> <u>base chance</u> to reduce each single enemy target's SPD by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> turn(s). Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.

skill_introduction.chinese: 对指定敌方单体造成等同于黄泉<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的雷属性伤害。
skill_introduction.english: Deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Acheron's ATK to one designated enemy target.

skill_introduction.chinese: 获得<unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak>点【残梦】，为指定敌方单体附上<unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak>层【集真赤】，对其造成等同于黄泉<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的雷属性伤害，同时对其相邻目标造成等同于黄泉<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的雷属性伤害。
skill_introduction.english: Gains <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> point(s) of "Slashed Dream." Inflicts <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> stack(s) of "Crimson Knot" on one designated enemy target, dealing Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Acheron's ATK to this target, as well as Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Acheron's ATK to adjacent targets.

skill_introduction.chinese:
依次发动3次【啼泽雨斩】和1次【黄泉返渡】，对指定敌方单体最多造成等同于黄泉<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#6[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的雷属性伤害，对其他目标最多造成等同于黄泉<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#7[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的雷属性伤害。
【啼泽雨斩】：对指定敌方单体造成等同于黄泉攻击力<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color>的雷属性伤害，并消去目标最多3层【集真赤】。消去【集真赤】时，立即对敌方全体造成等同于黄泉<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的雷属性伤害，每消去1层【集真赤】本次伤害倍率额外提高，最多提高至<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[f1]%</unbreak></color>。
【黄泉返渡】：对敌方全体造成等同于黄泉<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的雷属性伤害并移除所有【集真赤】。
终结技期间无法为敌方附上【集真赤】。
skill_introduction.english:
Sequentially unleash "Rainblade" 3 times and "Stygian Resurge" 1 time, dealing Lightning DMG up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#6[i]%</unbreak></color> of Acheron's ATK to one designated enemy target, as well as Lightning DMG up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#7[i]%</unbreak></color> of Acheron's ATK to other targets.
"Rainblade": Deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Acheron's ATK to one designated enemy target and removes up to 3 stacks of "Crimson Knot" from the target. When "Crimson Knot" is removed, immediately deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Acheron's ATK to all enemies. For every stack of "Crimson Knot" removed, this DMG Multiplier is additionally increased, up to a maximum of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[f1]%</unbreak></color>.
"Stygian Resurge": Deals Lightning DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Acheron's ATK to all enemies and remove all "Crimson Knots."
"Crimson Knot" cannot be applied to enemies during the Ultimate.

skill_introduction.chinese: 【残梦】达到<unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>点时可激活终结技。终结技期间可无视弱点属性削减敌方韧性，并使敌方全体全属性抗性降低<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>，持续至终结技结束。\n任意单位施放技能期间使敌方目标陷入负面效果，黄泉获得1点【残梦】并为目标附上1层【集真赤】，若使多个目标陷入负面效果，则为其中【集真赤】最多的敌方目标附上1层【集真赤】。该效果每次施放技能最多触发1次。\n黄泉在场时，敌方目标离场或被任意单位消灭后，其持有的【集真赤】会转移至全场【集真赤】最多的敌方目标。
skill_introduction.english: When Slashed Dream reaches <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> point(s), the Ultimate can be activated. During the Ultimate, reduces enemies' Toughness regardless of Weakness Types and reduces all enemies' All-Type RES by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>, lasting until the end of the Ultimate.\nWhen any unit inflicts debuffs on an enemy target while using their ability, Acheron gains 1 point of Slashed Dream and inflicts 1 stack of Crimson Knot on a target. If debuffs are inflicted on multiple targets, then the 1 stack of Crimson Knot will be inflicted on the enemy target with the most Crimson Knot stacks. This effect can only trigger once for every ability use.\nAfter an enemy target exits the field or gets defeated by any unit while Acheron is on the field, their Crimson Knot stacks will be transferred to the enemy target with the most Crimson Knot stacks on the whole field.

skill_introduction.chinese: 攻击敌人，进入战斗后削弱敌方目标对应属性韧性。

skill_introduction.chinese: 立即攻击敌人，每个波次开始时获得【四相断我】，对敌方全体造成等同于黄泉<unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>攻击力的雷属性伤害，且无视弱点属性削减敌方全体的韧性，击破弱点时，触发雷属性的弱点击破效果。\n【四相断我】：施放终结技后黄泉获得<unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>点【残梦】，并为敌方随机单体附上<unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>层【集真赤】。\n若攻击普通敌人则立即将其消灭，不会进入战斗。未击中敌人时不消耗秘技点。
skill_introduction.english: Immediately attacks the enemy. At the start of each wave, gains Quadrivalent Ascendance, dealing Lightning DMG equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of Acheron's ATK to all enemies and reducing Toughness of all enemies irrespective of Weakness Types. When breaking Weaknesses, triggers the Lightning Weakness Break effect.\nQuadrivalent Ascendance: After using the Ultimate, Acheron gains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> point(s) of Slashed Dream and inflicts <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> stack(s) of Crimson Knot on a single random enemy.\nIf attacking a normal enemy, immediately defeats them without entering combat. When not hitting enemies, no Technique Points are consumed.

skill_introduction.english: Deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Boothill's ATK to one designated enemy target.

skill_introduction.chinese: 对指定敌方单体造成等同于波提欧<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的物理属性伤害。\n强化普攻无法恢复战技点，且仅能以处于【绝命对峙】的敌方目标为目标。
skill_introduction.english: Deals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Boothill's ATK to one designated enemy target.\nThe Enhanced Basic Attack cannot recover Skill Points and can only target the enemy that is in the "Standoff" state.

skill_introduction.chinese:
使指定敌方单体及自身进入【绝命对峙】状态，波提欧普攻获得强化且无法施放战技，持续<unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak>回合，波提欧每回合开始时持续回合数减1。

该目标被消灭或弱点被击破后，波提欧均可获得1层【优势口袋】，随后解除【绝命对峙】。
该战技无法恢复能量。施放该战技后，本回合不会结束。
skill_introduction.english:
Forces Boothill and one designated enemy target into the "Standoff" state. Boothill's Basic ATK gets Enhanced, and he cannot use his Skill, lasting for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of Boothill's every turn.
The enemy target in the "Standoff" becomes Taunted. When this enemy target/Boothill gets attacked by the other party in the Standoff, the DMG they receive increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>/<unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.
After this target is defeated or becomes Weakness Broken, Boothill gains 1 stack of "Pocket Trickshot," then dispels the "Standoff."
This Skill cannot regenerate Energy. After using this Skill, the current turn does not end.

skill_introduction.chinese: 为指定敌方单体添加物理弱点，持续<unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak>回合。\n对该目标造成等同于波提欧<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的物理属性伤害，并使其<u>行动延后</u><color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>。
skill_introduction.english: Applies Physical Weakness to one designated enemy target, lasting for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turn(s).\nDeals Physical DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Boothill's ATK to the target and <u>delays their action</u> by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.

skill_introduction.chinese: 每层【优势口袋】使强化普攻的削韧值提高<unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak>，最多叠加<unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak>层。\n施放强化普攻期间，若目标处于<u>弱点击破状态</u>，基于【优势口袋】层数，对目标造成等同于波提欧<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>/<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>/<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color>物理属性击破伤害的<u>击破伤害</u>，该伤害计入的韧性上限不超过普攻【蹄铁裂颅】基础削韧值的<unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak>倍。\n战斗胜利后，波提欧能够将【优势口袋】保留至下一次战斗中。
skill_introduction.english: Each stack of Pocket Trickshot increases the Enhanced Basic Attack's Toughness Reduction by <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak>, stacking up to <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak> time(s).\nIf the target is <u>Weakness Broken</u> while the Enhanced Basic ATK is being used, based on the number of Pocket Trickshot stacks, deals <u>Break DMG</u> to this target equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>/<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>/<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Boothill's Physical Break DMG. The max Toughness taken into account for this DMG cannot exceed <unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak> times the base Toughness Reduction of the Basic Attack "Skullcrush Spurs."\nAfter winning the battle, Boothill can retain Pocket Trickshot for the next battle.

skill_introduction.chinese: 为我方全体附上【伴舞】效果，持续<unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>回合，开拓者每回合开始时持续回合数减1。持有【伴舞】的我方目标击破特攻提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color>，并且攻击处于<u>弱点击破状态</u>下的敌方目标后，会将本次攻击的削韧值转化为1次<u>超击破伤害</u>。

And when they attack enemy targets that are in the <u>Weakness Broken state</u>, the Toughness Reduction of the attack will be converted into 1 instance of <u>Super Break DMG</u>.

知更鸟进入【协奏】状态，使除自身以外的队友立即行动。

name.english: A Rain of Blades Seals Fate

skill_introduction.chinese:
消耗等同于千冶•刃生命上限<unbreak>#4[f1]%</unbreak>的生命值对敌方全体造成等同于千冶•刃<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>生命上限的火属性伤害，并额外造成<unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>次伤害，每次伤害对随机敌方单体造成等同于千冶•刃<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color>生命上限的火属性伤害。
若当前生命值不足，施放战技时千冶•刃的当前生命值降低至1点。
未处于【无量忿怒】状态或当前生命值小于等于1时，千冶•刃无法施放战技。
施放战技时不消耗战技点。
skill_introduction.english:
Consumes HP equal to <unbreak>#4[f1]%</unbreak> of Mortenax Blade's Max HP and deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Mortenax Blade's Max HP to all enemies, and additionally deals <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Mortenax Blade's Max HP to one random enemy.
If the current HP is insufficient, Mortenax Blade's current HP will be reduced to 1 when he uses Skill.
While not in the "Infinite Fury" state or when the current HP is 1 or lower, Mortenax Blade cannot use his Skill.
Using Skill does not consume Skill Points.

skill_introduction.chinese:
使敌方全体陷入【煞火缠身】，【煞火缠身】状态下的敌方目标防御力降低<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#7[f1]%</unbreak></color>，受到的伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[f1]%</unbreak></color>，持续<unbreak>#8[i]</unbreak>回合。随后消耗等同于千冶•刃生命上限<unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>的生命值展开结界，结界持续期间，千冶•刃获得【无量忿怒】状态。
【无量忿怒】状态下暴击率提高<unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>，暴击伤害提高<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color>，普攻获得强化，同时解放战技并获得全新终结技【千冶铸一，万劫烬灭】，若受到致命攻击时，不会陷入<u>无法战斗状态</u>，但会解除结界退出【无量忿怒】状态并回复等同于自身<unbreak>#6[i]%</unbreak>生命上限的生命值。
获得【无量忿怒】状态时，行动序列上出现对应倒计时，倒计时固定拥有<unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak>速度，倒计时回合开始时结界解除且退出【无量忿怒】状态。
若当前生命值不足，施放本技能时千冶•刃的当前生命值降低至1点。
skill_introduction.english:
Inflicts "Balefire Bind" on all enemies. Enemy targets in the "Balefire Bind" state have their DEF reduced by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#7[f1]%</unbreak></color> and the DMG they receive increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[f1]%</unbreak></color>, lasting for <unbreak>#8[i]</unbreak> turn(s). Then, consumes HP equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of Mortenax Blade's Max HP to deploy a Zone. While the Zone is active, Mortenax Blade enters the "Infinite Fury" state.
During the "Infinite Fury" state, increases CRIT Rate by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>, increases CRIT DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color>, enhances Basic ATK, unlocks Skill, and gains a new Ultimate "Tenax Per Ignem." When receiving a killing blow, this unit will not be <u>knocked down</u>, but will dispel the Zone, exit the "Infinite Fury" state, and restore HP equal to <unbreak>#6[i]%</unbreak> of this unit's Max HP.
When gaining the "Infinite Fury" state, a corresponding countdown appears on the Action Order. The countdown has a fixed SPD of <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak>. At the start of the countdown's turn, dispels the Zone and exits the "Infinite Fury" state.
If the current HP is insufficient, Mortenax Blade's current HP will be reduced to 1 when he uses this ability.

skill_introduction.chinese: 结界持续期间，我方目标每次攻击敌方后，使对应敌方目标陷入【煞火缠身】状态并使千冶•刃获得1点充能，当充能达到<unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>点且当前生命值大于1时，消耗<unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>点充能，恢复<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]</unbreak></color>点能量，并使千冶•刃额外施放1次战技，本次战技视为<u>追加攻击</u>。
skill_introduction.english: While the Zone is active, after each attack an ally target uses on an enemy, inflicts the "Balefire Bind" state on the corresponding enemy target and grants 1 Charge to Mortenax Blade. When Charge reaches <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> points and the current HP is more than 1, consumes <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Charge, regenerates <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]</unbreak></color> Energy, and enables Mortenax Blade to use Skill 1 extra time. This extra Skill use is considered as <u>Follow-Up ATK</u>.

skill_introduction.english: After using Skill, immediately recovers all <u>Assist Skill</u> uses. Himeko • Nova gains "Navigator's Semaphore," lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of Himeko • Nova's every turn. When Himeko • Nova has "Navigator's Semaphore," DMG dealt by all allies increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. At the start of every turn, immediately recovers 1 <u>Assist Skill</u> use.

skill_introduction.chinese: 立即操控「拓星者」，「拓星者」拥有可对敌方发动6次的【超频粒子光束】或消耗<u>【源能】</u>发动的【轨道歼灭脉冲】，对指定敌方单体最多造成等同于姬子•启行<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#9[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的火属性伤害，对其他目标最多造成等同于姬子•启行<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#10[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的火属性伤害。\n当【超频粒子光束】次数耗尽时，会自动发动【轨道歼灭脉冲】，随后发动最后一击，造成<unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak>次伤害，每次伤害对敌方随机单体造成等同于姬子•启行<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#7[i]%</unbreak></color>攻击力的火属性伤害。\n施放【超频粒子光束】或【轨道歼灭脉冲】对场上所有敌方造成致命伤害或敌方无法被继续削减生命值时，会立即发动最后一击。
skill_introduction.english: Immediately takes control of "Starblazer." "Starblazer" can launch "Hyperluminal Particle Beam" against enemies 6 times, or consume <u>"Source Energy"</u> to launch "Orbital Annihilation Pulse," dealing Fire DMG up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#9[i]%</unbreak></color> of Himeko • Nova's ATK to one designated enemy, and Fire DMG up to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#10[i]%</unbreak></color> of Himeko • Nova's ATK to other targets.\nWhen the uses of "Hyperluminal Particle Beam" are depleted, automatically launches "Orbital Annihilation Pulse," followed by Final Hit, dealing <unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak> instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#7[i]%</unbreak></color> of Himeko • Nova's ATK to one random enemy.\nWhen "Hyperluminal Particle Beam" or "Orbital Annihilation Pulse" deals fatal damage to all enemies on the field, or when enemy HP can no longer be reduced, immediately launches Final Hit.
